seo_description: Questions, ideas or something not working? Get in touch with somewhere🎉, the free family holiday planner, by message on Instagram.

hero.heading: Get in touch
hero.lead: The quickest way to reach us is a direct message on Instagram. We read every message and reply as soon as we can.

sections.heading: What you can message us about
sections.text:
- **Help with the site,** such as signing in, family links or the draw
- **Something not working,** ideally with what you were doing and which device you were on
- **Ideas,** for new features or destinations you'd like a guide to
- **Your data,** such as a request to see or delete what we hold
- **Working together,** if you're a creator, a travel company or a journalist

sections.heading: Before you message
sections.text:
Lots of common questions are answered in our [FAQ](/faq). Creators can find out how we work together on the [creators page](/creators).

Please don't send your family link or sign-in links in a message. We'll never ask for them.
